title: Air–water exchange fluxes of phthalates and phenolics xenoestrogens on Xietang River and East Taihu Lake in Suzhou and the potential health risks
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,771-786
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00001G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Minhao Wang, Dongling Li, Ting Tong, Ziyu Zhang, Yuwei Xia, Xinhui Shi, Haifei Zhang, Kui Chen, Fang Wang, Xiaowei Tie, Lei Han
This study examines xenoestrogen concentrations in surface waters of Suzhou, focusing on air–water exchange fluxes. Results revealed low health risks from exposure however accumulative health effects should also be considered.
